reachability: Build time only. The one package that calls deepmerge is @rollup/plugin-node-resolve, which merges the bundler's own resolve options while Nitro and Vite build the site; no request, page or Content record reaches it, and the deployed server bundle contains no deepmerge code. The provider layers inherit the same build tooling through their Nuxt peer. Wiki peer-path inspection on 2026-11-08: duxt-wiki resolves the same Nuxt tooling as the provider layers; the installed Rollup caller clones literal defaults with deepmerge and applies later options by spread. Wiki parsing/cache reads and runtime queryCollection metadata helpers introduce no request or MDC input to that merge.
remediation: No patched release is published; follow the upstream advisory and drop this review once @rollup/plugin-node-resolve or deepmerge ships a fix.

reachability: Build and development only. @nuxt/content uses Zod 3 in its build module to describe collection schemas, over this repository's own documentation, not over request input; its runtime imports no Zod, and the server bundle carries Zod 4 alone. The site's nuxtseo-layer-devtools reaches it through @nuxt/ui for the devtools panel, which never ships.
remediation: Zod 3 has no patched release; the fix is Zod 4.6.6, outside the ranges @nuxt/content and @nuxt/ui declare. Drop this review once they move to Zod 4.

reachability: Build-time only: @vercel/nft (Nitro file tracing, glob 13) and archiver-utils (Nitro output archiving, glob 10). The flaw is that an aborted async walk keeps reading directories after its AbortSignal fires; neither parent passes caller-controlled patterns or relies on a signal to bound traversal of untrusted trees, and duxt, its providers and apps/www never import glob — their AbortSignal uses all bound fetch requests. Nothing in a served request reaches glob. Wiki peer-path inspection on 2026-11-08: duxt-wiki inherits the same Nuxt/Nitro build callers; file tracing runs at buildEnd without an AbortSignal, and output archiving uses the fixed **/* pattern over build output. Wiki metadata processing adds no request-controlled traversal or cancellation boundary.
remediation: The fix is glob 14.0.2, outside the ranges @vercel/nft (^13) and archiver-utils (^10) declare. Drop this review once nitropack ships parents that accept glob 14.

reachability: Build- and tooling-time only: @nuxt/content matches source include/exclude patterns from the site's own content.config, and glob, readdir-glob, @vercel/nft and the vite-plugin-checker eslint chain match patterns from build configuration. The denial of service needs an attacker-controlled pattern; every pattern here is authored in the repository or a consumer's config, and no request, query or MCP argument is ever compiled into a minimatch pattern. Wiki peer-path inspection on 2026-11-08: duxt-wiki inherits the same Nuxt tooling; glob 10/13 enable optimizationLevel 2 only for build patterns, while Nuxt enables only vueTsc in vite-plugin-checker. The optional ESLint/config-array matchers use configured patterns with dot: true and default optimizationLevel 1. Wiki requests and authored MDC never supply a pattern to these callers. Re-check on 2026-11-12 after nuxt 4.6.4: archiver now resolves readdir-glob to minimatch 10.2.6 instead of the unaffected 5.1.9. readdir-glob is the same caller as before, matching patterns from build configuration while Nitro packs build output; no request input reaches it.
remediation: The fix is minimatch 11.0.1, outside the ranges its parents declare (10, 9 and 5). Drop this review once @nuxt/content, glob, readdir-glob and eslint accept minimatch 11.
